answer_1.quote: In this work, we address the aforementioned drawbacks and present DIBIMT, to the best of our knowledge the first fully manually-curated evaluation benchmark aimed at investigating the impact of semantic biases in MT in five language combinations, covering both nouns and verbs.

answer_2.quote: In addition to accuracy, DIBIMT analyzes the semantic biases of a translation model via four novel metrics, which we define in detail in what follows.
